leads.title: The mountain of the Lord's house; the Day of YHWH against all that is proud ↔ The disbelievers, the help, and the flame
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: When God's help and the opening (al-fath) come, people enter God's religion in crowds; the prophet is to glorify and seek forgiveness (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in The mountain of the Lord's house; the Day of YHWH against all that is proud: Stop trusting man, who has only breath in his nostrils; On that day people throw their silver and gold idols to the moles and bats and flee into clefts of the rocks; Foreign priests and diviners advise how to appease the God of Israel; On God's day all that is lofty (cedars of Lebanon, oaks of Bashan, towers, ships of Tarshish) is brought low and God alone exalted; In the latter days the mountain of God's house will be raised above all mountains and all nations will stream to it; Nations will beat swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks and learn war no more; 'From Zion shall go forth Torah and the word of YHWH from Jerusalem'; God shatters the ships of Tarshish with an east wind; God the Judge is called to judge between two nations; People hide in caves, thickets, rocks and pits from an invading army; On the day of judgment voices are hushed before the Merciful; only a faint murmur is heard; Prophecy concerning 'the end of days'; and 2 more.

Only in The disbelievers, the help, and the flame: Curse on Abu Lahab ('father of flame'): his hands perish, he will burn in a fire of flame, and his wife carries firewood with a rope of palm fiber (masad) on her neck; Repeated mutual disavowal: 'I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship'; 'to you your religion and to me mine'; Foreign daughter-in-law swears to follow her mother-in-law: your people my people, your God my God [contrast between the texts]; A person's name declared to match his character: 'as his name is, so is he'; Wealth does not profit on the day of wrath.
The mountain of the Lord's house; the Day of YHWH against all that is proud: tagged by Claude (model), reading the Hebrew.
The disbelievers, the help, and the flame: tagged by Claude (model), reading the Arabic.

matches.note: idhā jāʾa naṣru llāhi wa-l-fatḥu wa-raʾayta n-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni llāhi afwājan ~ we-nāharû ʾēlāyw kol ha-ggôyim we-hālekû ʿammîm rabbîm ... wi-yōrēnû mi-ddrākāyw: peoples streaming in to God's way. Isaiah's is eschatological and centered on Zion, the Quran's is the Prophet's own lifetime.

passages.text: וְהָיָ֣ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית יְהוָה֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֖א מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל הַגּוֹיִֽם

וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל הַר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹרֵ֨נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם
وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
